name: mask-reveal-up
title: Mask Reveal Up
description: Lines reveal upward with a soft masked feel and compact stagger.
useWhen: A multi-line headline or stacked list needs a clean, contained upward reveal that exits at the end of the clip.
A neutral entrance that works across tones: product, editorial, corporate.
avoidWhen: The block must hold in place and never exit: use a one-way reveal such as per-character-rise.
The reveal should be character-level: use per-character-rise or bottom-up-letters.
author: Remocn
